program_name: PM Youth Business & Agriculture Loan Scheme
target_user: Pakistani residents aged 21-45; minimum age 18 for IT and e-commerce businesses
purpose: Concessional financing for startups, existing businesses, and agriculture
loan_range: Tier 1: PKR 0.5M at 0%; Tier 2: above PKR 0.5M to 1.5M at 5%; Tier 3: above PKR 1.5M to 7.5M at 7%

requirements.label: Applicant age is 21-45 years, or at least 18 for an IT/e-commerce business
requirements.next_step: Confirm the applicant's age and business category before applying.

requirements.label: Pakistani resident with a valid CNIC
requirements.next_step: Keep a valid CNIC and a clear scanned copy ready.

requirements.label: Application must be submitted through the official online portal
requirements.next_step: Prepare the business information required by the portal before starting the application.

requirements.label: Startups and existing SMEs owned by eligible youth may apply, including agriculture businesses
requirements.next_step: Confirm that the eligible applicant owns the business or qualifies through the partnership or company structure.

requirements.label: Financing may cover development, working capital, production, machinery, equipment, or eligible locally manufactured vehicles
requirements.next_step: Select the financing purpose and prepare a cost estimate or supplier quotation.

requirements.label: Security, documents, and final approval are subject to the participating bank
requirements.next_step: Ask the selected participating bank for its current document and security checklist.

target_user: People establishing a new micro-business or expanding an existing small business
purpose: Interest-free micro-enterprise financing for business establishment or expansion
loan_range: PKR 10,000-50,000; duration 10-36 months; initial application fee up to PKR 500

requirements.label: Application is made through an Akhuwat branch; loans are not offered online
requirements.next_step: Locate the nearest Akhuwat branch and apply in person.

requirements.label: Funds are for establishing a new business or expanding an existing one
requirements.next_step: Prepare a short explanation of the business and the intended use of funds.

requirements.label: Identity and appraisal documents are confirmed by the branch
requirements.next_step: Ask the branch for its current application and appraisal checklist.

requirements.label: Published duration is 10-36 months and the initial application fee is up to PKR 500
requirements.next_step: Confirm the offered duration, installment schedule, and exact fee at the branch.

target_user: SME customers aged 21-60 with at least one year of banking relationship with BOP
purpose: Digital working-capital running finance for selected existing BOP customers
loan_range: PKR 0.1M-3.5M; one-year revolving facility; 1-year KIBOR + 9.99% per annum

requirements.label: Applicant age between 21 and 60 years
requirements.next_step: Confirm the applicant's age before requesting a digital application.

requirements.label: At least one year of banking relationship with BOP
requirements.next_step: Confirm the BOP relationship period and whether the bank has selected the customer.

requirements.label: Application is submitted through a digital link shared by BOP with selected customers
requirements.next_step: Request confirmation from BOP that the customer is eligible to receive the application link.

requirements.label: Personal guarantee of the borrower
requirements.next_step: Ask BOP for the current personal-guarantee documentation.

requirements.label: Debt burden ratio must not exceed 40%
requirements.next_step: Have BOP calculate the official debt burden ratio from verified obligations.

requirements.label: Monthly markup is due at month-end and is charged on the utilized amount
requirements.next_step: Review the expected monthly markup and maintain enough balance before each due date.

requirements.label: Published processing fee is PKR 9,500 including FED; published late-payment charge is PKR 2,000 including FED per overdue month
requirements.next_step: Confirm the latest schedule of charges with BOP before accepting the facility.

target_user: Resident Pakistani business owners aged 25-65 with at least three years in operation
purpose: Working capital, guarantees, letters of credit, and business expansion
loan_range: Up to PKR 20M, secured by acceptable residential, commercial, or industrial real estate

requirements.label: Sponsor, mortgagor, or borrower is a resident Pakistani aged 25-65
requirements.next_step: Confirm age and residency and keep CNIC copies ready.

requirements.label: Business has operated for at least 36 months
requirements.next_step: Keep dated business records that demonstrate at least three years of operation.

requirements.label: Acceptable real estate is required as mortgage security
requirements.next_step: Prepare property title, tax, valuation, and legal-vetting documents.

requirements.label: Certified bank statement for the last year
requirements.next_step: Obtain a certified 12-month bank statement.

requirements.label: CNIC, application form, photographs, utility bill, business data, and business constitution documents
requirements.next_step: Prepare the identity and business documents listed by HBL for the applicable ownership structure.

requirements.label: Property title, tax receipts, collateral evaluation, and legal vetting are required
requirements.next_step: Collect current title and tax records for the property offered as security.

requirements.label: Running Finance is on demand; Demand Finance and Letter of Guarantee are up to three years; Letter of Credit is up to 180 days
requirements.next_step: Choose the facility that matches the business need and confirm its repayment schedule with HBL.

requirements.label: Running Finance uses three-month average asking KIBOR plus spread; Demand Finance uses one-year average asking KIBOR plus spread
requirements.next_step: Request a written quotation showing the current KIBOR, bank spread, fees, and total repayment cost.

provider: Meezan Bank / State Bank of Pakistan
target_user: New or existing SMEs that are not current borrowers of Meezan Bank
purpose: Shariah-compliant working capital or term finance for equipment, machinery, vehicles, or property
loan_range: Up to PKR 10M at a published 9% per annum

requirements.label: Applicant is not a current Meezan Bank borrower and uses the facility through one bank only
requirements.next_step: Confirm current borrowing relationships before applying.

requirements.label: Facility is available as term finance or a working-capital line
requirements.next_step: Choose between working capital and long-term asset financing based on the intended use.

requirements.label: CNIC copies of proprietor, partners, or directors
requirements.next_step: Prepare clear CNIC copies for the relevant business owners.

requirements.label: Last three years of accounts, stock report, ageing of receivables, and six-month bank statement for a small enterprise
requirements.next_step: Compile the financial records listed on Meezan Bank's SME page.

requirements.label: Company profile, financing request, borrower fact sheet, personal net-worth statement, and constitutional documents where applicable
requirements.next_step: Prepare the documents for the business's legal structure and have required forms signed and stamped.

requirements.label: Collateral or security is assessed under Meezan Bank's internal policy
requirements.next_step: Ask the bank to confirm security requirements for the requested facility.
